zh.title: 亞維安卡航空航班遇嚴重亂流轉降邁阿密 9人送醫
zh.summary: 亞維安卡航空航班遇嚴重亂流；轉降邁阿密；9人送醫治療
body: 根據 Simple Flying 的標題，亞維安卡航空（Avianca）一架航班遭遇嚴重亂流。
同一標題指出，該航班其後轉降邁阿密，事件中有9人送醫。
Simple Flying 的摘要提到，乘客與機組人員在突發的飛行中亂流後接受治療，航班因緊急醫療需求轉降邁阿密。
目前可確認的資訊僅限於 Simple Flying 的報導內容；關於亂流發生的具體時間、飛行階段、機型與後續調查情況，來源並未提供。

en.title: Avianca flight hits severe turbulence, diverts to Miami; 9 hospitalized
en.summary: Avianca flight hits severe turbulence; diverts to Miami; nine people hospitalized
body: An Avianca flight hit severe turbulence, according to Simple Flying's headline.
The same headline states the flight diverted to Miami and that nine people were hospitalized.
Simple Flying's summary said passengers and crew were treated after sudden midflight turbulence forced the diversion to Miami and urgent hospital care.
The available information is limited to Simple Flying's report; the source did not provide the time, phase of flight, aircraft type or any investigation details.

zh.title: 尾流亂流是什麼 航空網站說明成因與飛安影響
zh.summary: 航空網站說明尾流亂流由機翼升力產生的旋轉氣流造成；較重與較慢的飛機尾流較強；並提及2022年美軍F-35事故調查
body: 航空新聞網站Aerospace Global News刊出一篇說明性文章，解釋尾流亂流（wake turbulence）如何形成，以及它對飛行安全的影響。文章指出，飛機起飛、飛越上空或進場落地時，會在身後留下肉眼看不見的擾動氣流，多數情況下很快消失，但在特定條件下足以影響另一架飛經當地的飛機。
文章說明，尾流亂流是飛機產生升力時造成的大氣擾動，由機翼後方形成的旋轉氣流團、也就是尾流渦流（wake vortices）所造成。機翼產生升力時，機翼下方氣壓較高、上方較低，空氣在翼尖周圍流動，形成兩股尾隨飛機的旋轉氣流，即翼尖渦流。
文章指出，一般而言飛機越重，尾流越強，並以需要產生大量升力的大型滿載客機波音787為例，對比小型Cessna 152教練機。速度也有影響：飛機飛得慢時，機翼必須更費力產生足夠升力，可能使渦流更強。
文章舉出實例：2022年一架美國空軍F-35在接近猶他州Hill Air Force Base時墜毀，調查認定另一架F-35的尾流亂流是造成事故的原因之一。該次遭遇導致飛機出現非預期反應，調查同時指出飛航程序問題與其他促成因素。
在管理方面，文章說航空管制員透過隔離要求，讓飛機保持足夠間距，以免受到另一架飛機尾流影響。

en.title: Explainer: what wake turbulence is and how wake vortices affect flight safety
en.summary: Aerospace Global News explainer covers how wake vortices form from lift; heavier and slower aircraft leave stronger wake; a 2022 F-35 crash investigation is cited
body: Aerospace Global News published an explainer describing what wake turbulence is and how it affects flight safety. It says that when an aircraft takes off, flies overhead or comes in to land, it leaves behind an invisible trail of disturbed air, which most of the time quickly disappears without causing problems but in the right conditions can be strong enough to affect another aircraft flying through it.

The article says wake turbulence is a disturbance in the atmosphere caused by an aircraft as it generates lift, created by rotating masses of air called wake vortices that form behind an aircraft's wings. As the wings produce lift, higher pressure below and lower pressure above cause air to move around the wingtips, creating two spinning currents of air that trail behind the aircraft, known as wingtip vortices.

On strength, the article says that in general the heavier the aircraft, the stronger its wake, citing a large, fully loaded passenger aircraft like a Boeing 787 compared with a small Cessna 152 training aircraft. It adds that when an aircraft is flying slowly, its wings need to work harder to produce enough lift, which can make the vortices stronger.

The article cites a real-world example in 2022, when a US Air Force F-35 crashed while approaching Hill Air Force Base in Utah; an investigation found that wake turbulence from another F-35 contributed to the accident. The encounter caused an unexpected aircraft response, and the investigation also identified pilot procedural issues and other contributing factors.
On management, the article says air traffic controllers use separation requirements to keep aircraft far enough apart for the wake from one aircraft.

zh.title: 回顧Air Europe：從蓋特威克包機航空到泛歐航空集團的興衰
zh.summary: Air Europe於1979年自蓋特威克機場首航；1980年代擴張為跨國航空集團，後因競爭與油價等因素結束營運
body: 根據Aerospace Global News的回顧報導，Air Europe於1979年5月4日從倫敦蓋特威克機場（LGW）展開營運，當時是一家英國包機航空公司，初期以波音737自蓋特威克出發。報導指出，該公司前一年以Inter European Airways之名成立，創辦人包括前Dan-Air主管Errol Cossey與Martin O'Regan，以及旅遊業者Intasun Leisure創辦人Harry Goodman。
報導說明，這家新航空公司的主要目的，是為Intasun快速擴張的套裝度假業務提供飛機。Air Europe最初以三架全新的波音737-200 Advanced客機投入營運，1979年在曼徹斯特開設第二個基地，1982年再增設卡地夫基地；報導稱當時機隊已成長至七架波音737，每年載客超過一百萬人次。
報導指出，Air Europe於1985年5月2日推出第一條定期航線，連結蓋特威克與帕爾馬，同年稍後加入直布羅陀，1986年再增曼徹斯特至直布羅陀航線。報導並提到，慕尼黑於1987年12月加入，巴黎於1988年2月、布魯塞爾於同年4月跟進，公司逐漸從英國包機業者轉型為定期歐洲航空公司。
報導指出，Air Europe在1980年代於蓋特威克建立相當規模，並在數個歐洲國家收購及成立航空公司，建立起跨越國界的網絡；報導稱其母公司International Leisure Group（ILG）掌控Intasun，而Air Europe負責提供載運Intasun旅客所需的飛機與機位。
報導指出，到1980年代末，Air Europe之名已不再只代表一家英國航空公司，而是涵蓋英國、愛爾蘭、西班牙、德國、挪威與義大利等地業者的集團門面。報導稱，該公司最終因競爭加劇、燃油價格上漲與經濟衰退，使其泛歐雄心受挫，並加速結束營運。

en.title: Air Europe remembered: from Gatwick charter flights to a pan-European airline group
en.summary: Air Europe began Gatwick flights in 1979; it grew into a cross-border airline group before competition, fuel costs and recession ended operations
body: Air Europe began flying from London Gatwick Airport (LGW) on 4 May 1979 as a British charter airline operating Boeing 737s, according to a retrospective by Aerospace Global News. The report said the carrier had been created the previous year as Inter European Airways by former Dan-Air executives Errol Cossey and Martin O'Regan, together with Harry Goodman, founder of tour operator Intasun Leisure.

The report said the new airline's principal purpose was to provide aircraft for Intasun's expanding package-holiday business. Air Europe began operations with three new Boeing 737-200 Advanced aircraft, opened a second base at Manchester in 1979 and added Cardiff in 1982, by which time it had seven Boeing 737s and was carrying more than a million passengers a year.

According to the report, Air Europe launched its first scheduled service on 2 May 1985, linking Gatwick with Palma de Mallorca, with Gibraltar following later that year and Manchester to Gibraltar added in 1986. Munich was added in December 1987, followed by Paris in February 1988 and Brussels in April, as the airline moved further into scheduled European flying.

The report said Air Europe built a substantial presence at Gatwick during the 1980s, acquired and established airlines in several European countries and created a network crossing national borders. Its parent company, International Leisure Group (ILG), controlled Intasun, and Air Europe supplied the aircraft and seats needed to carry Intasun's holidaymakers, the report said.

By the end of the decade, the report said, the Air Europe name had become the public face of carriers stretching from Britain and Ireland to Spain, Germany, Norway and Italy. The report said increasing competition, rising fuel prices and economic recession derailed its pan-European plans and expedited the end of the carrier and its ambitions.
